title: Web Visual Picking - Pick Order Details
description: Traces every field of GET /cwp/v1/picking/pickOrder back through the EBBA API, Dapper stored-procedure calls, T-SQL expressions, tables, functions and system parameters. First X-Ray case; also the 1024 demo.

knownGaps.reason: Storage bin procedure for destination wagons: the site configuration names it (PickingOptions.StorageBinProcedure, provided 2026-09-17) but its definition has not been provided yet.
Multi pick order flow is out of scope: not part of the demo, left as a documented gap.
